papers.title: Learning Through Mistakes: Explainable Medical Question-Answering using Reinforcement Learning in Large Language Models
MedMCQA: A Large-scale Multi-Subject Multi-Choice Dataset for Medical domain Question Answering

training_data.name: MedMCQA
training_data.quote: The first stage involves Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), where the model is trained on the full MedMCQA dataset 183,000 training and 4,180 validation samples. Missing explanations were filled using GPT-4.1-mini.

training_method.objective_quote: The finetuning was performed using SFT following by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

source_claims.quote: This model is a finetuned version of Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
Fine-tuning of the quantized Qwen-2.5-0.5B-Instruct model.

description.text: BioXP-0.5B is a Medical-AI model trained using our two-stage fine-tuning approach: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on MedMCQA, then Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

output_type.quote: Identify the right answer and elaborate your reasoning

use_claim.quote: fine-tuned on labeled data(MedMCQA) to achieve strong baseline accuracy on multiple-choice medical QA tasks.

warning.quote: This model should not be used for generating harmful, biased, or inappropriate content.

purpose_stated.quote: BioXP-0.5B is a Medical-AI model trained using our two-stage fine-tuning approach

serving.system_prompt: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
serving.notes: The card example also sets max_new_tokens=200. The chat template's default system line is the Qwen helper sentence above; it is used when the caller does not pass a system message. No adapter_config.json. Safetensors total 494032768, float16. The paper's GRPO sampling (temperature 0.6, top_p 0.9) is a training setting, not the shipped generation_config. SFT is described as 7 epochs and GRPO as 2 epochs, both at learning rate 3e-5. A later results sentence says one GRPO figure used 50k samples and reached 64.36%, while the abstract and the card say 64.58%. The card links a Space at rgb2gbr/BioXP-0.5b-v2; the model API lists abaryan/BioXP-0.5b-v2.

evaluation_reported.text: The card says the final model achieves 64.58% accuracy on MedMCQA. The TechRxiv abstract says zero-shot about 23%, SFT about 52%, and the final model 64.58%. The same paper later says a GRPO run reached 64.36% using 50k samples, and that reasoning quality was scored on 2,205 development items that have explanations (BERTScore 0.834 for the chosen sampling setting).
